item_name: Rothco Enhanced Molded Silent Key Holder
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Enhanced Molded Silent Key Holder is designed to discreetly and securely carry your keys while on duty. The hook & loop closure ensures your keys stay tightly wrapped, reducing noise and minimizing the risk of loss. Constructed from durable polyester, the key holder offers a professional appearance without compromising strength. Its snap closure securely fastens your keys in place, while the compact design integrates seamlessly with most standard duty belts and tactical gear.
